scope: Read-only static audit of SET22 with no current network, compared across retained Tahoe host and pinned El Cap OCLP samples

leave_network_command.current_bss_null: skips current-BSS virtual gate; reason remains zero

fsm_event4.states1_2_3_5: leaveNetwork; active link-down path, not proven to be a no-op

cache.flush_requires: flag bit0 AND saved current BSS nonnull

family_entry.fallback: apple80211setDISASSOCIATE only if WCL absent/unhandled or designated unsupported status

leave_network_sync.interpretation: busy/in-progress success path only; does not prove all-zero BSSID or missing current BSS acceptance

4331.otherwise: skips command34; clears local auth state; returns 0

43224.otherwise: skips command34; clears local/interface state; returns 0

legacy_child.predicate_semantics: private config bytes are not proven equivalent to null current BSS or all-zero BSSID

conclusion.native_null_current_bss_reason: requested nonzero reason is reduced to zero before WCL FSM dispatch
conclusion.native_null_current_bss_flush: flag remains independent but no saved BSS means no selective cache removal; no global purge evidenced
successful_empty_state_examples: Tahoe FSM state0 event4 joinAbort returns0
Tahoe FSM state4/6 event4 ignore returns0
both pinned old child handlers can skip command34 and return0
conclusion.general_empty_state_idempotence: not established for every state/handler path; Family fallback and active WCL states may perform more work
conclusion.dk_policy_assessment: rejecting when a safe current-network identity cannot be built is conservative; samples do not justify unconditional success for every zero BSSID
conclusion.later_prune: a distinct linkDownInd handler can prune under its own event condition; no evidence links that action to an ignored SET22 flush flag
conclusion.verified_idle_success_condition: only when WCL state is LINK_DOWN and no association/leave is in flight; not inferred from BSSID alone

limits: Static disassembly only; no runtime execution.
A null WCL current-BSS slot is not proven equivalent to an all-zero BSSID or every disconnected FSM state.
Old child config-byte predicates are opaque for the question of association state.
No end-to-end statement is made about firmware/AP completion or the status of every downstream active-state IOUC.

joinAbort.interpretation: no proven in-flight association cancellation or BSS release in this body

state4_bss_window.event3_skip: selector-0x1a9 status 0xe0821806 plus manager/controller predicates can skip processEvent(3)
state4_bss_window.consequence: state4 can persist with current BSS not cleared; later event4 is ignored; ignored request flush is not saved

completion_timing.normal_active_state: leaveNetwork synchronously calls cmdIouc selector 0x1a9, then processEvent(3), whose linkDownComplete executes conditional cache removal before returning
completion_timing.special_skip: event3 and its flush prune may be skipped while the 0x1a9 status is returned
completion_timing.no_op_branch_deferred_flush: joinAbort/ignore do not save the request flush bit; a separate linkDownInd may later prune by its own event-derived gate, not by this SET22 flag

metadata_split.reason: gated/zeroed before event4; handled in selector 0x1a9 native vendor-IE path when leaveNetwork runs
metadata_split.flush: carried separately in event payload; acts only in event3 when flag is set and saved BSS is nonnull
metadata_split.reason_only_vs_flush_only: not separately async-acknowledged; active path can execute 0x1a9 with reason zero and then prune; if event3 is skipped only the reason-side call may have run
metadata_split.normal_active_path: direct synchronous selector 0x1a9 call then processEvent(3); selective removal runs inline before return unless the documented special skip branch applies
metadata_split.no_op_path: state0 joinAbort and state4/6 ignore return zero without forwarding or storing this request reason/flush

followup_completion.identity_boundary: all-zero BSSID or no child worker is not proven equivalent to WCL FSM state0 with no in-flight leave

independent_linkDownInd.current_bss: retains the then-current BSS at entry when nonnull
independent_linkDownInd.gate: event-derived r13b bit and current BSS nonnull
independent_linkDownInd.request_correlation: none established; later independent prune cannot be attributed to ignored SET22 flush

minimal_success_case.required_state: WCL FSM LINK_DOWN state0 receiving event4
additional_stipulated_conditions: no association or leave in flight
minimal_success_case.equivalence: a legacy request handler that completes its own local cleanup and returns0 is equivalent at request-result and network/cache-effect boundaries for this narrow case
minimal_success_case.unsafe_inference: all-zero BSSID alone does not prove LINK_DOWN state or no operation in flight
